svhud_toggle.onDown: extensions.load('survivalhud'); if extensions and extensions.survivalhud then extensions.survivalhud.svhudToggle() end
svhud_toggle.title: SURVIVAL HUD: ON/OFF
svhud_toggle.desc: Show or hide the Survival Chance HUD.

svhud_reset.onDown: extensions.load('survivalhud'); if extensions and extensions.survivalhud then extensions.survivalhud.svhudReset() end
svhud_reset.title: SURVIVAL HUD: Reset run

svhud_panel.onDown: extensions.load('survivalhud'); if extensions and extensions.survivalhud then extensions.survivalhud.svhudPanel() end
svhud_panel.title: SURVIVAL HUD: Toggle options panel
svhud_panel.desc: Show or hide the SURVIVAL HUD config panel.
